name: @sderickson/hub-dev
description: Docker compose setup for dev environment

scripts.dev: saf-docker build --compose docker-compose.yaml && saf-dev-site sync-node-modules && saf-dev-site compose up -V
scripts.up: saf-docker build --compose docker-compose.yaml && saf-dev-site sync-node-modules && saf-dev-site compose up --detach -V
